title: Trump urges France, UK, China to help open Strait of Hormuz as Iran war enters third week
summary: Two weeks after the US and Israel attacked Iran, prompting Tehran to block the Strait of Hormuz, US President Donald Trump on Saturday urged France, Britain, China, Japan and South Korea to help secure the shipping lane through which 20% of global oil and gas travels.
